findings.body: An entry such as `- Sign-in: ask the client  (salesperson, 2026-09-28)` passes ANSWER_LINE but stores `ask the client ` with a trailing space. The exact comparison in open_must_answer_topics then treats it as settled, so `forge next` omits the unanswered topic. Normalize surrounding whitespace before classifying reserved markers, or classify these entries as malformed.
findings.title: Keep whitespace-padded open markers unresolved

findings.body: If Answers contains both `- Sign-in: email and password (client, 2026-09-28)` and `* Sign-in: ask the client (salesperson, 2026-09-28)`, the second entry is silently discarded because topic recognition requires the exact `- ` prefix. The first entry therefore makes Sign-in appear settled despite the repeated, malformed entry. Identify recognizable topic labels independently of format validation, then retain invalid entries as malformed so they keep the topic open.
findings.title: Retain malformed duplicates when identifying topic entries
